scan_cost_interpretation.all_field_scan: Parquet file bytes is a sequential full-file read envelope; all-column chunk sums exclude footer and some file overhead.
scan_cost_interpretation.content_projection: Uses only content fields already declared in the two importers, not a sensitivity classifier. Additional metadata columns may contain personal/sensitive values.
scan_cost_interpretation.broad_text_projection: All string/large_string columns, including user/author/URL/path/annotation metadata; no values classified or decoded.
scan_cost_interpretation.uncompressed_estimate: Footer uncompressed sizes are encoded Parquet column page bytes, not UTF-8 text length, Python RAM, tokens, or elapsed time.
scan_cost_interpretation.nonnull_estimate: Derived only from footer null counts; non-null includes empty/placeholder/invalid/duplicated values and never proves usable content.
scan_cost_interpretation.json_and_lists: All native fields are scalar; serialized JSON/list shape is only verified where existing importer array validation already reports it.

scope_boundary.aidev_rows_not_unique_prs: Overlapping all_pull_request/pull_request/human_pull_request and repeated file-level commit messages remain separate source-table rows; not a deduplicated PR/person/log denominator.
